title: Mall Infrastructure Package: Time Impact Analysis
scope: Internal roads and utility networks for a retail mall. A client-instructed sewer diversion (CD-07) is modelled as a fragnet to show its impact on completion.
assume: Six corridors: trench, sewer (DN450), water (DN200), duct bank, then subbase, asphalt and curbs.
TIA: fragnet CD-07 (instruction, redesign, procurement, construction) inserted ahead of corridor 3 utilities. Impact = impacted finish minus unimpacted finish.
